stories.title: CIA director's visit to Cuba echoes past memories of U.S. in Latin America
stories.summary: CIA Director John Ratcliffe makes a surprise visit to Cuba as the spy agency calls on the nation to make "fundamental changes." Cuba says it has run out of fuel and is suffering massive blackouts.

stories.title: The White House is planning a big prayer event. Almost all the speakers are Christian
stories.summary: As the White House prepares for a prayer event tied to the nation's 250th anniversary, some question why the lineup is almost entirely Christian.

stories.title: 'Pocket gardens' give native plants a place to thrive in cities
stories.summary: "Pocket gardens" of native plant species are becoming more common in urban areas. We tag along with a volunteer tending to tiny gardens in a neighborhood of Washington, D.C.

stories.title: How a nurse helped a mom through open heart surgery
stories.summary: Barb Barnes faced a very difficult moment in 2005, after she underwent major open heart surgery. A nurse helped her through it.

stories.title: Remembering Joe Sedelmaier, director of iconic 1970s and '80s TV ads
stories.summary: We remember Joe Sedelmaier, the man behind some of the most iconic TV ads of the 1970s and '80s. The commercials were not splashy, but their characters and catchphrases became part of popular culture.

stories.title: 'Is God Is' is an astonishing debut from a playwright-turned-filmmaker
stories.summary: A southern gothic tale of familial revenge, Is God Is finds first-time filmmaker Aleshea Harris adapting her own play for the screen.
